attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A pebble of green glass, tumbled smooth. It holds the light like pond water.

attrs.Label: Ranger's Last Log
attrs.LoreText: "Final entry: the storm didn't come from the sky. It came up FROM THE RIVER — embers that remembered being afraid. We got everyone out. The spirits… stayed."

attrs.Label: Ring-Carved Stone (first)
attrs.LoreText: Rings within rings, carved long before the city. When you touch it, it hums — faintly, eastward, toward the morning sun.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: An acorn cap someone very small once used as a lantern. The wax still smells warm.

attrs.ClearText: The haze over the Whispering Woods thins. Birdsong returns.

attrs.Label: The Old Arch
attrs.LoreText: Moss has grown into carved letters, older than the city: "EVERY LOST THING IS KEPT. EVERY KEPT THING IS LOVED."

attrs.Label: The Worn Warden
attrs.LoreText: A stone figure holds out a lantern. Rain has smoothed its face away, but someone still leaves fresh flowers at its feet.

attrs.Whisper: Someone wove the fallen branches into a ring. The woods lean in, listening.

attrs.Label: Ring-Carved Stone (second)
attrs.LoreText: A second ring-stone, leaning against the old arch. The hum is stronger here. It remembers moving water. Follow the river's smell.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A brass token: ADMIT ONE — EVERYONE ADMITTED ANYWAY.

attrs.ClearText: The park breathes easier — blankets and kites are coming back out.

attrs.Label: Bandstand Cornerstone
attrs.LoreText: "BUILT BY THE FIRST WATCH — FOR EVERYONE WHO NEEDS A PLACE TO REST." Below, smaller, hand-cut: "even the small ones. especially the small ones."

attrs.Whisper: A perfect ring of moss, older than the lawns around it. Grass will not grow across the line.

attrs.Label: Ring-Carved Stone (third)
attrs.LoreText: Half-buried in the wall's gap, ring upon ring like a compass rose of moss. The needle, if it is one, points east.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A coiled spring that still ticks, faintly, when you hold your breath.

attrs.ClearText: The smoke over the brick streets clears. Windows reopen one by one.

attrs.Label: Tally Marks
attrs.LoreText: Scratched into the clock tower brick: thousands of tiny tally marks. Someone counted 4,748 chimes… and then stopped counting, mid-stroke.

attrs.Whisper: Little towers of balanced stones, up here where only pigeons go. Each one is somebody's quiet wish.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A pigeon feather dipped in forty winters of chimney smoke.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: Fool's gold shaped like a tiny fist. Heavier than it has any right to be.

attrs.ClearText: The river wind sweeps the Great Bridge clean. The far shore looks closer than ever.

attrs.Label: The Bronze Plate
attrs.LoreText: Polished bright by a hundred years of passing hands: "CROSS GENTLY. THE BRIDGE REMEMBERS EVERY FOOTSTEP — EVEN YOURS."

attrs.Whisper: A spiral of river stones, laid with enormous patience. It points nowhere. It points inward.

attrs.Label: Ring-Carved Stone (fourth)
attrs.LoreText: Rings like ripples, under the pier where the water claps softly. Across the great crossing, it says. Past it. Below the bank.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: Grey driftwood worn into a wishbone. The river's handwriting.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A cooled ember from the night the river burned. It dreams in orange when nobody looks.

attrs.Label: Chalk on the Wall
attrs.LoreText: In a worker's hurried hand: "If the pipes sing at night, don't be scared. That's just the river dreaming. —S"

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A flake of old pipe. Struck gently, it hums the river's one long note.

attrs.ClearText: The great ember over the firehouse gutters out. The watch is kept once more.

attrs.Label: The Soot Mural
attrs.LoreText: Under years of soot, a painted mural: firefighters and forest spirits standing shoulder to shoulder, holding one long hose line together. The oldest figure wears a strange, tall helmet.

attrs.Whisper: Storm-glass, fused the night the river burned — gathered and set in a careful circle. Grief, tidied.

attrs.Label: Ring-Carved Stone (last)
attrs.LoreText: The last ring-stone, cold as a held breath. Where the conifers huddle north of the bridge — the Old Ways keep a hollow there.

attrs.Label: Hidden Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A stone core drilled by patient water over a thousand years. Rings all the way down.

attrs.Label: Weathered Box
attrs.SpecimenText: A knot of driftwood polished by a thousand slides down the old lido. It smells like summer rain.

attrs.Label: Frozen Cache
attrs.SpecimenText: A teardrop of ancient ice that never melts. Deep inside, a tiny bubble of some winter long ago.
